agentmemory.configuration_behaviour: collapses scopes, which is a true statement about the tested configuration
agentmemory.evidence: adapter contract: 'never a project or agent per scope', and 'smart-search does not isolate by project anyway'
agentmemory.mechanism: one agentId and one project namespace for every scope
agentmemory.why: no scope filter is passed on either path, so the engine is never asked to isolate; a scope failure here is the configuration's, not evidence about the product

hindsight.configuration_behaviour: collapses scopes, which is a true statement about the tested configuration
hindsight.evidence: recall arguments are bank_id, query, max_tokens - no scope term
hindsight.mechanism: bank_id is per repetition; scope appears only inside a context string
hindsight.why: no scope filter is passed on either path, so the engine is never asked to isolate; a scope failure here is the configuration's, not evidence about the product

mem0.configuration_behaviour: collapses scopes, which is a true statement about the tested configuration
mem0.evidence: adapter contract: 'scored_filter: constant user_id only, exactly as Gen10'
mem0.mechanism: scope stored in metadata; queries filter on a constant user_id
mem0.why: no scope filter is passed on either path, so the engine is never asked to isolate; a scope failure here is the configuration's, not evidence about the product

perseus.evidence: body carries scope; write and recall both take workspace_hash derived from the case scope
perseus.why: a scope filter is supplied on both paths, so honouring or violating it is the engine's own behaviour

distinction.scope_isolated: scope filter supplied on write and query; engine behaviour is measured
distinction.scope_not_exercised: no scope filter supplied; configuration collapses scopes and engine capability is not demonstrable

contract.method: the Gen75 rule applied to scope: prove a class can fire before reporting its zero, and separate engine capability from what the harness asked
contract.why_it_matters: Gen71 read an adapter routing decision as an engine property on the temporal axis; the same error is available here and this module exists to prevent it
